svg.title: Ports, island floras and butterfly host opportunities
svg.desc: Four source-defined panels. A: port coefficients and HC3 intervals for 126 island floras, including the uncertain introduced-minus-native contrast. B: native and introduced flora median Jaccard over 7,875 pairs of those islands. C: relative MSE reduction from undirected marine electrical resistance in a separate 104-island cohort; both-islands-unseen intervals include zero. D: Mainland isolation and candidate butterfly food. Fixed panel of 239 butterfly species across 126 islands; native-host coverage is nested within contemporary coverage. The unchanged fitted count curves use log1p distance. A separate share model uses 123 resource-active islands. Its nine-Level1 p is 0.014; the paired count-slope contrast p is 0.068 and its interval includes zero. Opportunities are mapped known-host availability, not butterfly occurrence. E: base and MEM10 taxonomic rank distance slopes with clustered intervals. F: native-minus-introduced seawater dispersal morphology.
